title: Dup key silently overwriting → dup-key build gate, no dynamic keys, honest about unused-key detection
gate: A dup key silently overwriting → adds a dup-key build gate, forbids dynamic keys, is honest unused-key detection is incomplete.
expected: The JSON/YAML parser silently overwrites an already-defined key, so a duplicate key is a silently broken, untested feature. Make dup-key detection a build GATE (a CI test that fails on any duplicate + redefinition at the same hierarchical level). Keep keys grep-able (ASCII letters/digits/hyphens/underscores) and NEVER dynamically constructed. Be honest: there is no perfect unused-key story — static misses dynamic usage, runtime misses rare features.
mustRefuse: we can fully detect unused keys
